# Playbook

> Four workflow skills for AI coding agents, as plain Markdown SKILL.md files: plan, debug, tdd (test-first), review. Under 20 lines each. No hooks. Four short skill descriptions (about 160 tokens) load each session; each skill's full text loads only when used.

Install (Claude Code): /plugin install playbook-skills --marketplace MOHJRNL/playbook
Other agents: copy the skill bodies into AGENTS.md (Codex, OpenCode) or GEMINI.md (Gemini CLI).

## Docs
- [README](README.md): skills, per-tool install, FAQ
- [plan](skills/plan/SKILL.md), [debug](skills/debug/SKILL.md), [tdd](skills/tdd/SKILL.md), [review](skills/review/SKILL.md)
